name: 91732 · El Monte, CA
findings: ZIP 91732 (El Monte) has 78 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (22%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 91732 (El Monte) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 91732 (El Monte) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 57% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 23 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.
